tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, ensuring reliable, low-latency transaction handling deployed on Azure.
Built Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform using the MERN stack across three independent services, implementing JWT-based authentication and a server-side API proxy with in-memory caching.
Developed DriftGuard as a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool flagged against compliance controls, deployed end-to-end within a hackathon timeline.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team at Coinbase India Services, I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer Intern role at Coinbase India Services. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to building scalable web applications and technical products. Professionally, I worked as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, where I built and launched a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, featuring role-based access control and an administrative dashboard. Additionally, I delivered a Point of Sale system for a restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deployed on Azure. In my projects, I built Zenvest, a trading platform clone using the MERN stack featuring JWT authentication and server-side proxy caching, and DriftGuard, a real-time security control drift detection tool. My background aligns with developing robust backend systems and full-stack solutions. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical skills match your engineering internship requirements. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed

screening_answers.why_this_company: Coinbase is seeking software engineer interns to build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features while solving unique, large-scale, highly complex technical problems.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The role focuses on solving complex technical problems and building production-ready features, which directly aligns with my experience developing full-stack applications like a POS system and a tours management platform using Node.js, Angular, Express, and databases such as MySQL and MS SQL Server.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on full-stack development experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built a production-ready system with Angular, Node.js, and MySQL, alongside freelance work deploying a POS system on Azure using C# and MS SQL Server. My project portfolio includes building full-stack web applications with authentication and third-party API integrations.
